The figure 293067 is measured, not estimated.

done record (apps/storytime/lib/done.ts): DONE_STORAGE_KEY is "storytime:done". isPartDone and markPartDone each wrap the JSON.parse in a try/catch and return false or write nothing on a blocked or hostile store, so a broken value fails safe. The key is <level>:<week>:<part>, scoped by the route level and week.

done mark (done-mark.tsx): it reads the record in a useEffect after the first render, so the server HTML and the first client render agree, and it renders nothing when the part is not done. The record logic sits in lib/done.ts and the component holds no business logic.
writes: reader.tsx marks on the last page or the end view, decodable.tsx on its last page, and song.tsx in onEnded. page.tsx builds the key from the route level and week with doneKeyOf(part).
no new transport surface: git show a3b4dc50b --name-only lists no file under app/api, lib/auth, or a cookie, header, or route file (exit 0). No server schema change.

word gap (apps/storytime/app/look.css): the rule [data-part="decodable"] section[data-page-number] > p { word-spacing: 0.25em } sits at line 533, and the 48 px box stays in the button rule at lines 536 to 539. word-spacing acts on word separators only, so it opens no space before a stop. The rule is scoped to the decodable, so the reader sentence keeps its plain space.

first word box (decodable.tsx): wordBoxStyle returns marginInlineStart min(0px, calc(Nch - 48px)) and justifyContent flex-end for the first word, and marginInline min(0px, calc((Nch - 48px) / 2)) for the rest. A negative margin moves the box and does not shrink the 48 px border box, so the tap target holds and the first word reads with the same gap as the rest.

song chip (song.tsx and look.css): the gesture label span carries data-action-chip, and the rule [data-part="song"] ol li > span > span[data-action-chip] sets font-size 16px, color var(--sq-navy) (#13244e) and background-color #dce8f8. That rule and span:last-child have equal specificity (0,2,4) and the chip rule is later, so it wins; the active line rule sets background #fff6d4 and keeps the navy colour.

contrast: navy #13244e on #dce8f8 is (0.847147)/(0.069545) = 12.18 to 1, and on cream #fffaf0 about 14.4 to 1, which matches the quoted mode_button_contrast_min=14.52 inside rounding. Both are 4.5 to 1 or more.

no line before playback (song.tsx): activeLine starts at useState(-1), and onTimeUpdate sets the line whose interval holds the current time after the lead-in. No line is active before playback, and the active line follows playback.
